component.name: OktoSpace
component.summary: Install, update and build apps from GitHub

description.p: OktoSpace installs, updates and builds apps from GitHub: an App library of open-source apps and any repository you add, installed from their releases or built from source, and kept up to date in one place.

ul.li: Installs per user, or as system packages through dnf or apt
Checksum-verified downloads that resume, with update channels and rollback
Builds apps from source (Cargo, Go, CMake, Meson, npm and more) and installs them
Over 300 open-source apps in the App library, plus any GitHub repository
